steps.do: Ask for any of these the customer has not given: the expected deposit and whether it is new money, whether the two share an address, and whether the referred business is new to Rho-Bank with a different primary owner

steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: Check eligibility before recommending anything. (a) Count referral bonuses in the 9 days before the current time; if there are already 2, a new referral would be auto-denied. (b) Confirm the two do not share an address. (c) Confirm the referred business is new to Rho-Bank with a different primary owner. (d) Compute tenure from the earliest checking account.
steps.quote: If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.

steps.do: Tell the customer they cannot submit the referral now and why, in general terms. Give no product recommendation.
steps.if: the rolling window is full, they share an address, the referred party is not new or has the same owner, or no program's tenure is met
steps.quote: Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 9-day window.

steps.do: Keep only the business checking programs where the referred deposit meets the required deposit, the referrer's tenure meets the minimum, and the referrer's referrals for that type this calendar year are below its annual cap. Recommend the one with the highest referrer bonus.
steps.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements.

steps.do: Explain the recommended account, the referrer bonus and the referred business's bonus. Also explain the required deposit and deadline, that the deposit must be new money held at least 30 days, and the 90-day clawback.
steps.quote: The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends.

steps.do: Customer submits the referral for the recommended account

rules.rule: Check the referrer's eligibility before giving any recommendation or any referral terms
rules.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

rules.rule: At most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window, counted across all checking account types. A 3rd is auto-denied.
rules.quote: This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.

rules.rule: Tenure is measured from the date the earliest checking account was opened, whatever account type the referrer holds
rules.quote: Consequently, holding one account type does not prevent you from referring someone to a different account type, as long as the duration since your first account meets or exceeds the program's stated minimum.

rules.rule: The referrer and the referred person must not share a registered address
rules.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

rules.rule: The referred party must be new: no Rho-Bank accounts, and none closed in the past 12 months
rules.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

rules.rule: For a business referral, the referred business's primary owner (by SSN) must differ from the owner of any existing Rho-Bank business account
rules.quote: For business accounts: The referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer.

rules.rule: The qualifying deposit must be new money, not a transfer from another Rho-Bank account
rules.quote: The qualifying deposit must be new money and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account.

rules.quote: To qualify: The referred business must open a Navy Blue account and deposit at least $5,000 within 90 days of account opening. Referrer eligibility requires having been a Rho-Bank checking customer for 60 days or more.

open_questions: The documents do not say which referral statuses count toward the 2-per-9-day cap ('referral bonuses'). The safest reading is to count every referral dated within the last 9 days except REJECTED and ERROR ones.

The annual caps are written per program ('per year' or 'per calendar year'). The documents do not say whether a cap counts referrals made or bonuses paid. Count the referrer's referrals of that account type in the current calendar year.
The World Blue and Sky Blue pages describe 'international businesses' and 'startups' but give no eligibility rule that excludes other businesses, so they are not treated as restrictions.
The documents name no greeting or verification-procedure document for referrals. Identity verification follows the general policy: 2 of DOB, email, phone and address, then log_verification.
